notes: litert-community/WeVisOne-VL-4B: WeVisOne-VL-4B_int4.litertlm, a LiteRT-LM fast_vlm conversion of tencent/WeVisOne-VL-4B (apache-2.0; WeChat Vision, Tencent; built on Qwen3-VL; converted from the float32 release at revision 4a7bed92, whose weights the current bfloat16 release 6b44a458 holds) — detection, referring, pointing, counting and OCR answers as <0>…<1000> coordinate tokens; to the segmentation and matting templates the file answers with a box and no mask (the pixel decoder is not in the file). Pictures are stretched to 512 x 512 before they are sent. Text-only conversations past 271 tokens shift the text positions (the first 271 tokens are exact). LiteRT-LM 0.18.1 and 0.19.1 feed the previous answer's stop token with a zero embedding from a conversation's second message on (files with an EMBEDDER section), so every row here is a one-question conversation except the suite's two_turn text row. Galaxy S26 rows: run r3 chain g1b (2026-10-27 23:36–23:5x JST, its own phone RFGL80R6A6H, the file's runs interleaved with the same weights without the GPU composites), the v0.18.1 tag build, which loads the tag's prebuilt GPU accelerator. Landed 2026-11-10: the file is on the Hub at litert-community/WeVisOne-VL-4B (upload commit cfe3cff01ca34625b017ab3e274f96cc87b18e5f, 2026-11-10 08:23:15 UTC = 2026-11-10 17:23:15 JST; main 2fcc2c196105741be5ea88ad7121b3fcc3c9dee8 at the read, the file unchanged there); its LFS oid equals artifact_sha256 and its size 3507874304 B (anonymous API read 2026-11-10 18:27:05 JST).
quantization: int4 blockwise-32 decoder weights (the output layer included) with one scale per block, every block scale at or above 2^-14 (ai-edge-quantizer 0.10.0); int8 token embedder (one scale per output channel); float16 vision encoder; float32 activations declared for the decoder; the decoder's KV-cache writes and attention products as GPU composites (odml.cache_update, odml.runtime_bmm); fast_vlm at 512 x 512 (256 image tokens), 10,244-wide image rows (Qwen3-VL DeepStack), KV cache 2048
